title: Hardship Reduction of Credit Builder Accounts Late Fees
content:
A Credit Builder late fee for a late due date with no more than one debit card payment credited toward it is reduced when the borrower is in a Larkspur hardship plan. The plans are the borrower's Hardship Assistance Programs plans, read from the borrower's hardship plan records: each plan's status and the program it is under.

## Reduction

- When the borrower has a Larkspur hardship plan in active status under the Disaster Relief Deferral program, the fee is multiplied by the disaster share of 0.25.
- When the borrower has a Larkspur hardship plan in active status and none of them is under the Disaster Relief Deferral program, the fee is multiplied by the hardship share of 0.5.
- When the borrower has no Larkspur hardship plan in active status, the fee is not reduced for hardship (a share of 1.0).

The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

| Borrower's Hardship Assistance Programs plans in active status | Share |
|---|---|
| at least one under the Disaster Relief Deferral program | 0.25 |
| one or more, none under the Disaster Relief Deferral program (for example a Reduced Payment Plan or a Temporary Rate Reduction Plan) | 0.5 |
| none (plans only in other statuses, or no plan) | no reduction |

## Hypothetical figures

An unrounded fee of 4.00 becomes 1.00 for a borrower with an active Disaster Relief Deferral plan, 2.00 for a borrower whose only active plan is a Short-Term Payment Deferral, and stays 4.00 for a borrower whose hardship plan is no longer active.
